game.title: Pokémon Yellow
game.revision_note: Sources label these codes 'USA/Europe' without distinguishing Yellow's ROM revisions. If a code misbehaves, revision differences may be why.

codes.name: Infinite Money
codes.description: Maxes out the player's money. Enter all three lines together. Note: some newer sites print the middle line as 019947D0 — the D3 form matches the older dedicated code databases.
side_effects: Load and save your game with all cheats OFF — saving with cheats active can corrupt the save.

codes.name: Rare Candy enabler
codes.description: Enabler line that sources say must be entered and active before the Rare Candy code works. Add it as its own cheat in Delta and enable both.

codes.name: Unlimited Rare Candies in PC
codes.description: Fills a PC item-storage slot with Rare Candies. Requires the Rare Candy enabler code active first.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw
side_effects: Activate no more than one or two cheats at once; never save with cheats enabled.

codes.name: Buy Master Balls at Poké Mart
codes.description: Makes Master Balls purchasable from the Poké Mart's first slot.
side_effects: Disable after buying; don't save with the cheat active.

codes.name: Infinite PP (first party Pokémon)
codes.description: Infinite PP for your first party Pokémon, one line per move slot 1–4. An alternative set (01282CD0…01282FD0) circulates on other sites — the two are not interchangeable.

codes.name: Walk Through Walls
codes.description: Walk through walls, obstacles and barriers.
side_effects: Toggle on only when needed and turn off after use; never load or save with cheats active.

codes.name: No Random Battles
side_effects: Don't save with the cheat active.

codes.name: Wild Pokémon at Level 100
codes.description: Wild encounters appear at level 100 (filled-in example of the level-modifier template, 64 hex = 100).
side_effects: Disable before saving; level-modified Pokémon have been reported to freeze the game when leveling up.

codes.name: Catch Other Trainers' Pokémon
codes.description: Throw a Poké Ball in a trainer battle and capture the opponent's Pokémon as if it were wild.
side_effects: Don't save with the cheat active.
